min_standing_note.value: Incoming exchange students must be officially nominated by their home university and remain in good academic standing as non-degree seeking study abroad students.
min_standing_note.notes: Official partner nomination rule also on AY 2026-27 Fact Sheet #page=2.

eligible_auc_schools.notes: University-wide Excel agreement; AY 2026-27 Fact Sheet #page=3 excludes Athletic Training, Law, Medicine, and Pharmacy, and restricts courses to Lawrence campus only.

eligible_majors.notes: Nearly 200 fields of study (Architecture/Design/Planning, Arts, Business, Engineering, Journalism & Mass Comm, Liberal Arts & Sciences, Music, Applied English Center per #page=1), excluding restricted health/law fields.

excluded_majors.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Kansas University/Fact Sheet 2026-27/KU Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=3
excluded_majors.notes: AY 2026-27 Fact Sheet #page=3 also states exchange students may only take courses at the Lawrence campus (excluding KU Med, Edwards, and Regents campuses) and Independent Study/research credit is typically unavailable.

min_gpa_host.notes: No minimum incoming exchange GPA stated in AY 2026-27 Fact Sheet (the 2.5 GPA on #page=2 applies solely to an English-proficiency test waiver for students who graduated from an English-language high school; 2.5 on KU Study Abroad pages applies to outgoing KU students).

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: TOEFL and IELTS scores are NOT required to apply for exchange at KU; however, all non-native English speakers must take the Applied English Center (AEC) English Proficiency Exam (online pre-arrival or at orientation) unless waived by TOEFL iBT >=79 (no subscore <18 UG / <23/section Grad) or IELTS >=6.5 (no subscore <6.0). Note 'Assessment of Functional Level of English' J-1 form does NOT waive the AEC exam. RHET 1020 exemption not mentioned.
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Kansas University/Fact Sheet 2026-27/KU Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=2

fall_term_dates.value: Fall 2026: Orientation Arrival Date 10 Aug 2026; Classes begin 24 Aug 2026; Labor Day 7 Sep; Fall Break 17–20 Oct; Thanksgiving Break 25–29 Nov; Final Exams end 18 Dec 2026 (https://registrar.ku.edu/calendar).
fall_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Kansas University/Fact Sheet 2026-27/KU Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=3

spring_term_dates.value: Spring 2027: Orientation Arrival Date 11 Jan 2027; MLK Day 18 Jan; Classes begin 19 Jan 2027; Spring Break 15–21 Mar 2027; Final Exams end 13 May 2027 (https://registrar.ku.edu/calendar).
spring_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Kansas University/Fact Sheet 2026-27/KU Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=3

tuition_model.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Kansas University/Fact Sheet 2026-27/KU Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=5
tuition_model.notes: AY 2026-27 Fact Sheet #page=5 confirms Tuition, Course Fees, Technology Fee, International Student Service Fee, Infrastructure Fee, Wellness Fee, and Campus Fee are covered by KU Study Abroad & Global Engagement (exchange application fee also waived via code 42626669ku in 2026 UG Application Instructions #page=1).

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived from KU International Admissions annual international undergraduate living expenses budget USD 18,424/yr (housing, food, personal items, books, mandatory health insurance) divided over 9 academic months = USD 2,047.11/month.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month USD estimate derived from KU International Admissions annual living expenses budget USD 18,424/yr (USD 2,047.11/mo over 9 months x 5 = USD 10,235.56; 1-semester half share = USD 9,212), verified 2026-11-15 (USD local currency; no FX conversion).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Students pay mandatory UnitedHealthcare health insurance (~USD 1,180/semester unless waived via https://iss.ku.edu/waivers by 1st day of class), Orientation Fee (USD 290), ISS Check-In Fee (USD 40), and KUID card (USD 21) — billed after arrival/enrollment.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Kansas University/Fact Sheet 2026-27/KU Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=5

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Kansas University/Fact Sheet 2026-27/KU Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=4

housing_notes.value: Exchange students arrange their own housing once admitted with KUID (https://housing.ku.edu; early move-in ~$40/night). On-campus options: apartments (Jayhawker Towers, Stouffer, McCarthy — open over breaks, optional dining) or Residence Halls (GSP, Corbin, Ellsworth, Hashinger open to all levels; mandatory dining plan at https://union.ku.edu/dining-plans; closed Winter Break unless extra fee paid). Fall-only students can opt out of Spring from AY contracts free of charge. Off-campus adjacent alternative: Naismith Hall (https://www.naismithhall.com/).
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Kansas University/Fact Sheet 2026-27/KU Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=4

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 Exchange Visitor (student) DS-2019 required; must arrive no later than DS-2019 Start Date (= Orientation Arrival Date). Proof of financial support must cover the ENTIRE J-1 duration using bank statements/letters <6 months old or sponsorship letters (+ signed Affidavit of Financial Support if not student's own funds) per https://iss.ku.edu/proof-finances and Fact Sheet #page=2,4.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Kansas University/Fact Sheet 2026-27/KU Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=4
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Also cites #page=2 (financial docs), 2026 UG Application Instructions #page=4 (select J-1 Exchange Visitor), and https://iss.ku.edu/proof-finances.

english_course_list_url.notes: All KU regular coursework at classes.ku.edu is in English.

credit_system_and_load.value: US semester credit hours. Exchange students must enroll full-time within exact caps: Undergraduates 12–15 credits/semester (typically 4–5 classes); Graduates 9 credits/semester (up to 12 max). Exceeding 15 UG / 12 Grad credits triggers direct tuition/fee charges; max 1 online course/semester.
credit_system_and_load.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Kansas University/Fact Sheet 2026-27/KU Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=3

course_restrictions_note.value: Enrollment blocked until AEC English test/waiver, 'You at KU' orientation registration, and health check-in appointment are completed. Must select Lawrence campus courses only (KU Med/Edwards/Regents prohibited), avoid Athletic Training/Law/Medicine/Pharmacy, and submit >=2 alternate courses. Independent Study/research credit typically unavailable; portfolios/auditions may apply for Architecture/Design/Art/Music.
course_restrictions_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Kansas University/Fact Sheet 2026-27/KU Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=3

value: Online 'KU Non-Degree Study Abroad' application via https://world.ku.edu/apply (enter exchange fee waiver code 42626669ku)
Official current university transcript + list of courses in progress
Assessment of Functional Level of English form (for J-1 DS-2019)
English test score report (optional, for AEC exam waiver)
Portfolio or audition (Architecture, Design, Visual Art, or Music only)
required_application_docs.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Kansas University/Fact Sheet 2026-27/KU Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=2
required_application_docs.notes: Fee waiver code 42626669ku and online portal steps confirmed in 2026 UG Application Instructions #page=1-5.

academic_style.value: Comprehensive US AAU research university (~30,000 students, ~200 majors) on 950-acre Mount Oread campus in Lawrence, KS; classes may combine large lectures with LAB/DIS sections; AEC coursework offered if English placement requires.
academic_style.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Kansas University/Fact Sheet 2026-27/KU Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=1
academic_style.notes: 950-acre Mount Oread campus figure confirmed on ku.edu.

international_support_services.value: Mandatory 'You at KU' orientation via ISS (https://iss.ku.edu/newly-admitted-students) including immigration check-in, shuttled shopping excursions, and social activities (#page=4); Applied English Center (https://studyabroad.ku.edu/applied-english-center); Campus Fee covers recreation/fitness center, campus bus, library, health center, >500 student groups (#page=1,5).
international_support_services.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Kansas University/Fact Sheet 2026-27/KU Exchange Fact Sheet 2026-27.pdf#page=4

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall / Full Academic Year: Nomination 1 March (at least 2 weeks pre-app) / Application 15 March; Spring: Nomination 1 October / Application 15 October.
